title: Allrecipes Scraper
description: Extract recipes from Allrecipes.com with ingredients, instructions, ratings, times, servings, and nutrition. Search by keyword or supply recipe, search, category, or gallery URLs.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Allrecipes recipe, search, category, or gallery URLs. When supplied, these take precedence over the Search Query field. Recipe URLs are scraped directly; search URLs are paginated up to Maximum Pages.

query.title: Search Query
query.description: Recipe search term, such as chicken pasta, chocolate cake, or vegan soup. Used only when Start URLs is empty. If left blank, the scraper uses chicken.

results_wanted.title: Maximum Recipes
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of recipes to save. The scraper stops after saving this many recipes.

max_pages.title: Maximum Pages per Search
max_pages.description: Maximum search-result pages to read for each query or search URL. Each page contains about 24 recipes.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Disabled by default because the Actor works from Apify's network without one. Enable Apify Residential Proxy if repeated runs return block pages. Residential proxy usage is billed by Apify.
